1: 1 Happy is the man that hath not walked in the counsel of the wicked, Nor stood in the way of sinners, Nor sat in the seat of the scornful. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But his delight is in the law of the Lord ; And in His law doth he meditate day and night. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And he shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, And whose leaf doth not wither; And in whatsoever he doeth he shall prosper. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Not so the wicked; But they are like the chaff which the wind driveth away, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the LORD regardeth the way of the righteous, But the way of the wicked shall perish. <span class="anchor"
2: 2 Why are the nations in an uproar? And why do the peoples mutter in vain? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The kings of the earth stand up, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the Lord , and against His anointed: <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let us break their bands asunder, And cast away their cords from us.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He that sitteth in heaven laugheth, The Lord hath them in derision. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Then will He speak unto them in His wrath, And affright them in His sore displeasure: <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Truly it is I that have established My king Upon Zion, My holy mountain.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will tell of the decree: The Lord said unto me: 'Thou art My son, This day have I begotten thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Ask of Me, and I will give the nations for thine inheritance, And the ends of the earth for thy possession. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Now therefore, ye kings, be wise; Be admonished, ye judges of the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Serve the LORD with fear, And rejoice with trembling. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Do homage in purity, lest He be angry, and ye perish in the way, When suddenly His wrath is kindled. Happy are all they that take refuge in Him.   ​ <span class="anchor"
3: 3 A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lord , how many are mine adversaries become! Many are they that rise up against me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Many there are that say of my soul: 'There is no salvation for him in God.' Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But thou, O Lord , art a shield about me; My glory, and the lifter up of my head. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
With my voice I call unto the Lord , And He answereth me out of His holy mountain. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I lay me down, and I sleep; I awake, for the Lord sustaineth me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am not afraid of ten thousands of people, That have set themselves against me round about. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Arise, O Lord ; save me, O my God; For Thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek, Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Salvation belongeth unto the Lord ; Thy blessing be upon Thy people. Selah <span class="anchor"
4: 4 For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness, Thou who didst set me free when I was in distress; Be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be put to shame, In that ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But know that the Lord hath set apart the godly man as His own; The Lord will hear when I call unto Him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Tremble, and sin not; Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Many there are that say: 'Oh that we could see some good!' Lord , lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than when their corn and their wine increase. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For Thou, Lord , makest me dwell alone in safety. <span class="anchor"
5: 5 For the Leader; upon the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Give ear to my words, O Lord , consider my meditation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto Thee do I pray. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , in the morning shalt Thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto Thee, and will look forward. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness; Evil shall not sojourn with Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The boasters shall not stand in Thy sight; Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou destroyest them that speak falsehood; The Lord abhorreth the man of blood and of deceit. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, in the abundance of Thy lovingkindness will I come into Thy house; I will bow down toward Thy holy temple in the fear of Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , lead me in Thy righteousness because of them that lie in wait for me; Make Thy way straight before my face. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For there is no sincerity in their mouth; Their inward part is a yawning gulf, Their throat is an open sepulchre; They make smooth their tongue. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Hold them guilty, O God, Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them down in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

So shall all those that take refuge in Thee rejoice, They shall ever shout for joy, And Thou shalt shelter them; Let them also that love Thy name exult in Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou dost bless the righteous; O Lord , Thou dost encompass him with favour as with a shield. <span class="anchor"
6: 6 For the Leader; with string-music; on the Sheminith. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , rebuke me not in Thine anger, Neither chasten me in Thy wrath. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be gracious unto me, O Lord , for I languish away; Heal me, O Lord , for my bones are affrighted. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My soul also is sore affrighted; And Thou, O Lord , how long? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Return, O Lord , deliver my soul; Save me for Thy mercy's sake. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For in death there is no remembrance of Thee; In the nether-world who will give Thee thanks? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I melt away my couch with my tears. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Mine eye is dimmed because of vexation; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord hath heard my supplication; The Lord receiveth my prayer. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All mine enemies shall be ashamed and sore affrighted; They shall turn back, they shall be ashamed suddenly. <span class="anchor"
7: 7 Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord , concerning Cush a Benjamite. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord my God, in Thee have I taken refuge; Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
If I have requited him that did evil unto me, Or spoiled mine adversary unto emptiness; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it, And tread my life down to the earth; Yea, let him lay my glory in the dust. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Arise, O Lord , in Thine anger, Lift up Thyself in indignation against mine adversaries; Yea, awake for me at the judgment which Thou hast commanded. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And let the congregation of the peoples compass Thee about, And over them return Thou on high. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , who ministerest judgment to the peoples, Judge me, O Lord , According to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Oh that a full measure of evil might come upon the wicked, And that Thou wouldest establish the righteous; For the righteous God trieth the heart and reins. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day: <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
If a man turn not, He will whet His sword, He hath bent His bow, and made it ready; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath also prepared for him the weapons of death, Yea, His arrows which He made sharp. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he conceiveth mischief, and bringeth forth falsehood. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath digged a pit, and hollowed it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will give thanks unto the Lord according to His righteousness; And will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High. <span class="anchor"
8: 8 For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , our Lord, How glorious is Thy name in all the earth! Whose majesty is rehearsed above the heavens. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast Thou founded strength, Because of Thine adversaries; That Thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When I behold Thy heavens, the work of Thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which Thou hast established; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
What is man, that Thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that Thou thinkest of him? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yet Thou hast made him but little lower than the angels, And hast crowned him with glory and honour. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast made him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things under His feet:  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sheep and oxen, all of them, Yea, and the beasts of the field; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea; Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , our Lord, How glorious is Thy name in all the earth! <span class="anchor"
9: 9 For the Leader; upon Muth-labben. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will give thanks unto the Lord with my whole heart; I will tell of all Thy marvellous works. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will be glad and exult in Thee; I will sing praise to Thy name, O Most High: <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When mine enemies are turned back, They stumble and perish at Thy presence; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sattest upon the throne as the righteous Judge. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast rebuked the nations, Thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O thou enemy, the waste places are come to an end for ever; And the cities which thou didst uproot, Their very memorial is perished. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But the Lord is enthroned for ever; He hath established His throne for judgment. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And He will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples with equity. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And they that know Thy name will put their trust in Thee; For thou, Lord , hast not forsaken them that seek Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sing praises to the Lord , who dwelleth in Zion; Declare among the peoples His doings. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For He that avengeth blood hath remembered them; He hath not forgotten the cry of the humble. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be gracious unto me, O Lord , Behold mine affliction at the hands of them that hate me; Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
That I may tell of all Thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion, That I may rejoice in Thy salvation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made; In the net which they hid is their own foot taken. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord hath made Himself known, He hath executed judgment, The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The wicked shall return to the nether-world, Even all the nations that forget God. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Arise, O Lord , let not man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Thy sight. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Set terror over them, O Lord ; Let the nations know they are but men. Selah <span class="anchor"
10: 10 Why standest Thou afar off, O Lord ? Why hidest Thou Thyself in times of trouble? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Through the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued, They are taken in the devices that they have imagined. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, And the covetous vaunteth himself, though he contemn the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The wicked, in the pride of his countenance [, saith]: 'He will not require'; All his thoughts are: 'There is no God.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
His ways prosper at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight; As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He saith in his heart: 'I shall not be moved, I who to all generations shall not be in adversity.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In secret places doth he slay the innocent; His eyes are on the watch for the helpless. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He lieth in wait in a secret place as a lion in his lair, He lieth in wait to catch the poor; He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him up in his net. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall into his mighty claws. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath said in his heart: 'God hath forgotten; He hideth His face; He will never see.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Arise, O Lord ; O God, lift up Thy hand; Forget not the humble. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart: 'Thou wilt not require'? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Thou hast seen; for Thou beholdest trouble and vexation, to requite them with Thy hand; Unto Thee the helpless committeth himself; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Break Thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, search out his wickedness, till none be found. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is King for ever and ever; The nations are perished out of His land. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lord , Thou hast heard the desire of the humble: Thou wilt direct their heart, Thou wilt cause Thine ear to attend; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To right the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more. <span class="anchor"
11: 11 For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David. In the Lord have I taken refuge; How say ye to my soul:  ​ 'Flee thou! to your mountain, ye birds'? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They have made ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When the foundations are destroyed, What hath the righteous wrought? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is in His holy temple, The Lord , His throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, His eyelids try, the children of men. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence His soul hateth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Upon the wicked He will cause to rain coals; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the Lord is righteous, He loveth righteousness; The upright shall behold His face. <span class="anchor"
12: 12 For the Leader; on the Sheminith. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Help, Lord ; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They speak falsehood every one with his neighbour; With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh proud things! <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who have said: 'Our tongue will we make mighty; Our lips are with us: who is lord over us?' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise', saith the Lord ; 'I will set him in safety at whom they puff.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The words of the Lord are pure words, As silver tried in a crucible on the earth, refined seven times. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou wilt keep them, O Lord ; Thou wilt preserve us from this generation for ever. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men. <span class="anchor"
13: 13 For the Leader. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
How long, O Lord , wilt Thou forget me for ever? How long wilt Thou hide Thy face from me? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart by day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Behold Thou, and answer me, O Lord my God; Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lest mine enemy say: 'I have prevailed against him'; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, in Thy mercy do I trust; My heart shall rejoice in Thy salvation. I will sing unto the Lord ,  ​ Because He hath dealt bountifully with me. <span class="anchor"
14: 14 For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David. The fool hath said in his heart: 'There is no God'; They have dealt corruptly, they have done abominably; There is none that doeth good. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord looked forth from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any man of understanding, that did seek after God. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They are all corrupt, they are together become impure; There is none that doeth good, no, not one. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Shall not all the workers of iniquity know it, Who eat up My people as they eat bread, And call not upon the Lord ?' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
There are they in great fear; For God is with the righteous generation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Ye would put to shame the counsel of the poor, But the Lord is his refuge. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When the Lord turneth the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad. <span class="anchor"
15: 15 A Psalm of David. Lord , who shall sojourn in Thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell upon Thy holy mountain? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
That hath no slander upon his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his fellow, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In whose eyes a vile person is despised, But he honoureth them that fear the Lord ; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He that putteth not out his money on interest, Nor taketh a bribe against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved. <span class="anchor"
16: 16 Michtam of David. Keep me, O God; for I have taken refuge in Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I have said unto the Lord : 'Thou art my Lord; I have no good but in Thee'; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
As for the holy that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the idols of them be multiplied that make suit unto another; Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup, Thou maintainest my lot. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will bless the Lord , who hath given me counsel; Yea, in the night seasons my reins instruct me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I have set the Lord always before me;  ​ Surely He is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; My flesh also dwelleth in safety; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou wilt not abandon my soul to the nether-world; Neither wilt Thou suffer Thy godly one to see the pit. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou makest me to know the path of life; In Thy presence is fulness of joy, In Thy right hand bliss for evermore. <span class="anchor"
17: 17 A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O Lord , attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer from lips without deceit. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let my judgment come forth from Thy presence; Let Thine eyes behold equity. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast tried my heart, Thou hast visited it in the night; Thou hast tested me, and Thou findest not That I had a thought which should not pass my mouth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
As for the doings of men, by the word of Thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My steps have held fast to Thy paths, My feet have not slipped. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
As for me, I call upon Thee, for Thou wilt answer me, O God; Incline Thine ear unto me, hear my speech. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Make passing great Thy mercies, O Thou that savest by Thy right hand From assailants them that take refuge in Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Keep me as the apple of the eye, Hide me in the shadow of Thy wings, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
From the wicked that oppress, My deadly enemies, that compass me about. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Their gross heart they have shut tight, With their mouth they speak proudly. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
At our every step they have now encompassed us; They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He is like a lion that is eager to tear in pieces, And like a young lion lurking in secret places. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Arise, O Lord , confront him, cast him down; Deliver my soul from the wicked, by Thy sword; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

From men, by Thy hand, O Lord , From men of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly Thou fillest with Thy treasure; Who have children in plenty, And leave their abundance to their babes. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
As for me, I shall behold Thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with Thy likeness. <span class="anchor"
18: 18 For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the Lord , who spoke unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-default"
And he said: I love thee, O Lord , my strength. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;  ​ My God, my rock, in Him I take refuge; My shield, and my horn of salvation, my high tower. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praised, I cry, is the Lord , And I am saved from mine enemies. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The cords of Death compassed me, And the floods of Belial assailed me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The cords of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of Death confronted me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In my distress I called upon the Lord , And cried unto my God; Out of His temple He heard my voice, And my cry came before Him unto His ears. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Then the earth did shake and quake, The foundations also of the mountains did tremble; They were shaken, because He was wroth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Smoke arose up in His nostrils, And fire out of His mouth did devour; Coals flamed forth from Him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under His feet. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For Thou dost save the afflicted people; But the haughty eyes Thou dost humble. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou dost light my lamp; The Lord my God doth lighten my darkness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Who maketh my feet like hinds', And setteth me upon my high places; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

19: 19 For the Leader. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The heavens declare the glory of God, And the firmament showeth His handiwork; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

There is no speech, there are no words, Neither is their voice heard. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The law of the Lord is perfect, restoring the soul; The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Moreover by them is Thy servant warned; In keeping of them there is great reward. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who can discern his errors? Clear Thou me from hidden faults. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Keep back Thy servant also from presumptuous sins, That they may not have dominion over me; then shall I be faultless, And I shall be clear from great transgression. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before Thee, O Lord , my Rock, and my Redeemer. <span class="anchor"
20: 20 For the Leader. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Send forth thy help from the sanctuary, And support thee out of Zion; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Receive the memorial of all thy meal-offerings, And accept the fat of thy burnt-sacrifice; Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Grant thee according to thine own heart, And fulfil all thy counsel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Save, Lord ; Let the King answer us in the day that we call. <span class="anchor"
21: 21 For the Leader. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , in Thy strength the king rejoiceth; And in Thy salvation how greatly doth he exult! <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

His glory is great through Thy salvation; Honour and majesty dost Thou lay upon him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou makest him most blessed for ever; Thou makest Mm glad with joy in Thy presence. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the king trusteth in the Lord , Yea, in the mercy of the Most High; he shall not be moved. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thy hand shall be equal to all thine enemies; Thy right hand shall overtake those that hate thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For they intended evil against thee, They imagined a device, wherewith they shall not prevail. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For thou shalt make them turn their back, Thou shalt make ready with thy bowstrings against the face of them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be Thou exalted, O Lord , in Thy strength; So will we sing and praise Thy power. <span class="anchor"
22: 22 For the Leader; upon Aijeleth ha-Shahar. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me, And art far from my help at the words of my cry? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O my God, I call by day, but Thou answerest not; And at night, and there is no surcease for me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yet Thou art holy, Thou that art enthroned upon the praises of Israel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In Thee did our fathers trust;  ​ They trusted, and Thou didst deliver them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Unto Thee they cried, and escaped; In Thee did they trust, and were not ashamed. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But I am a worm, and no man, A reproach of men, and despised of the people. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All they that see me laugh me to scorn, They shoot out the lip, they shake the head: <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let him commit himself unto the Lord ! let Him rescue him; Let Him deliver him, seeing He delighteth in him.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou art He that took me out of the womb, Thou madest me trust when I was upon my mother's breasts. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Upon Thee I have been cast from my birth; Thou art my God from my mother's womb. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be not far from me; for trouble is near; For there is none to help. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Many bulls have encompassed me; Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They open wide their mouth against me, As a ravening and a roaring lion. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For dogs have encompassed me, A company of evil-doers have inclosed me; Like a lion, they are at my hands and my feet. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

They part my garments among them, And for my vesture do they cast lots. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But Thou, Lord , be not far off; Thou my strength, hasten to help me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Deliver my soul from the sword; Mine only one from the power of the dog. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Save me from the lion's mouth; Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen do Thou answer me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will declare Thy name unto my brethren; In the midst of the congregation will I praise Thee: <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Ye that fear the Lord , praise Him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify Him; And stand in awe of Him, all ye the seed of Israel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For He hath not despised nor abhorred the lowliness of the poor; Neither hath He hid His face from him; But when he cried unto Him, He heard.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
From Thee cometh my praise in the great congregation, I will pay my vows before them that fear Him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the humble eat and be satisfied; Let them praise the Lord that seek after Him; May your heart be quickened for ever! <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto the Lord ; And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the kingdom is the Lord's ;  ​ And He is the ruler over the nations. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship; All they that go down to the dust shall kneel before Him, Even he that cannot keep his soul alive. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
A seed shall serve him, It shall be told of the Lord unto the next generation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They shall come and shall declare His righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that He hath done it. <span class="anchor"
23: 23 A Psalm of David. The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside the still waters. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He restoreth my soul; He guideth me in straight paths for His name's sake. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, For Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff, they comfort me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies; Thou hast anointed my head with oil; my cup runneth over. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of the Lord for ever. <span class="anchor"
24: 24 A Psalm of David. The earth is the Lord's , and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For He hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord ? And who shall stand in His holy place? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not taken My name in vain, And hath not sworn deceitfully <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He shall receive a blessing from the Lord , And righteousness from the God of his salvation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Such is the generation of them that seek after Him, That seek Thy face, even Jacob. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lift up your heads, O ye gates, And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors; That the King of glory may come in. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who is the King of glory?' 'The Lord strong and mighty, The Lord mighty in battle.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lift up your heads, O ye gates, Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors; That the King of glory may come in. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who then is the King of glory?' 'The Lord of hosts; He is the King of glory.' Selah <span class="anchor"
25: 25 [A Psalm] of David. א Unto Thee, O Lord , do I lift up my soul. ב <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O my God, in Thee have I trusted, let me not be ashamed; Let not mine enemies triumph over me. ג <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yea, none that wait for Thee shall be ashamed;  ​ They shall be ashamed that deal treacherously without cause. ד <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Show me Thy ways, O Lord ; Teach me Thy paths. הו <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Guide me in Thy truth, and teach me; For Thou art the God of my salvation; For Thee do I wait all the day. ז <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Remember, O Lord , Thy compassions and Thy mercies; For they have been from of old. ח <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; According to Thy mercy remember Thou me, For thy goodness' sake, O Lord . ט <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Good and upright is the Lord ; Therefore doth He instruct sinners in the way. י <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He guideth the humble in justice; And He teacheth the humble His way. כ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth Unto such as keep His covenant and His testimonies. ל <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thy name's sake, O Lord , Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great, מ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
What man is he that feareth the Lord ? Him will He instruct in the way that he should choose. נ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
His soul shall abide in prosperity, And his seed shall inherit the land. ס <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The counsel of the Lord is with them that fear Him; And His covenant, to make them know it. ע <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord ; For He will bring forth my feet out of the net. פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Turn Thee unto me, and be gracious unto me; For I am solitary and afflicted. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The troubles of my heart are enlarged; O bring Thou me out of my distresses. ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
See mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Consider how many are mine enemies, And the cruel hatred wherewith they hate me. ש <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in Thee. ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; Because I wait for Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles. <span class="anchor"
26: 26 [A Psalm] of David. Judge me, O Lord , for I have walked in mine integrity, And I have trusted in the Lord without wavering. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Examine me, O Lord , and try me, Test my reins and my heart. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thy mercy is before mine eyes; And I have walked in Thy truth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I hate the gathering of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will wash my hands in innocency; So will I compass Thine altar, O Lord , <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Lord , I love the habitation of Thy house, And the place where Thy glory dwelleth.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In whose hands is craftiness, And their right hand is full of bribes. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity; Redeem me, and be gracious unto me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My foot standeth in an even place; In the congregations will I bless the Lord . <span class="anchor"
27: 27 [A Psalm] of David. The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Hide not Thy face far from me; Put not Thy servant away in anger; Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For though my father and my mother have forsaken me, The Lord will take me up. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Wait on the Lord ; Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for the Lord . <span class="anchor"
28: 28 [A Psalm] of David. Unto thee, O Lord , do I call; My Rock, be not Thou deaf unto me; Lest, if Thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Blessed be the Lord , Because He hath heard the voice of my supplications. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

30: 30 A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House; of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will extol thee, O Lord , for Thou hast raised me up, And hast not suffered mine enemies to rejoice over me.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord my God, I cried unto Thee, and Thou didst heal me; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , Thou broughtest up my soul from the nether-world; Thou didst kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sing praise unto the Lord , O ye His godly ones, And give thanks to His holy name. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For His anger is but for a moment, His favour is for a life-time; Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy cometh in the morning. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Now I had said in my security: ' I shall never be moved.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hadst established, O Lord , in Thy favour my mountain as a stronghold— Thou didst hide Thy face; I was affrighted. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Unto Thee, O Lord , did I call, And unto the Lord I made supplication: <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise Thee? shall it declare Thy truth? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Hear, O Lord , and be gracious unto me; Lord , be Thou my helper.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou didst turn for me my mourning into dancing; Thou didst loose my sackcloth, and gird me with gladness; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
So that my glory may sing praise to Thee, and not be silent; O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto Thee for ever. <span class="anchor"
31: 31 For the Leader. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In thee, O Lord , have I taken refuge; let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in Thy righteousness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Incline Thine ear unto me, deliver me speedily; Be Thou to me a rock of refuge, even a fortress of defence, to save me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for Thy name's sake lead me and guide me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Bring me forth out of the net that they have hidden for me; For Thou art my stronghold. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Into Thy hand I commit my spirit; Thou hast redeemed me, O Lord , Thou God of truth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will be glad and rejoice in Thy lovingkindness; For Thou hast seen mine affliction, Thou hast taken cognizance of the troubles of my soul, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And Thou hast not given me over into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a broad place. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be gracious unto me, O Lord , for I am in distress; Mine eye wasteth away with vexation, yea, my soul and my body. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For my life is spent in sorrow, and my years in sighing; My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are wasted away. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbours exceedingly, and a dread to mine acquaintance; They that see me without flee from me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind;  ​ I am like a useless vessel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For I have heard the whispering of many, Terror on every side; While they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, I have trusted in Thee, O Lord ; I have said: 'Thou art my God.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My times are in Thy hand; Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; Save me in Thy lovingkindness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , let me not be ashamed, for I have called upon Thee; Let the wicked be ashamed, let them be put to silence in the nether-world. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak arrogantly against the righteous, With pride and contempt. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Oh how abundant is Thy goodness, which Thou hast laid up for them that fear Thee; Which Thou hast wrought for them that take their refuge in Thee, in the sight of the sons of men! <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hidest them in the covert of Thy presence from the plottings of man; Thou concealest them in a pavilion from the strife of tongues. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Blessed be the Lord ; For He hath shown me His wondrous lovingkindness in an entrenched city. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

O love the Lord , all ye His godly ones; The Lord preserveth the faithful, And plentifully repayeth him that acteth haughtily. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that wait for the Lord . <span class="anchor"
32: 32 [A Psalm] of David. Maschil. Happy is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is pardoned. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Happy is the man unto whom the Lord counteth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When I kept silence, my bones wore away Through my groaning all the day long. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me; My sap was turned as in the droughts of summer. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

I acknowledged my sin unto Thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid; I said: 'I will make confession concerning my transgressions unto the Lord '— And Thou, Thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For this let every one that is godly pray unto Thee in a time when Thou mayest be found; Surely, when the great waters overflow, they will not reach unto him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go; I will give counsel, Mine eye being upon thee.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, That they come not near unto thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Many are the sorrows of the wicked; But he that trusteth in the Lord , mercy compasseth him about. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be glad in the Lord , and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart. <span class="anchor"
33: 33 Rejoice in the Lord , O ye righteous, Praise is comely for the upright. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Give thanks unto the Lord with harp, Sing praises unto Him with the psaltery of ten strings. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sing unto Him a new song; Play skilfully amid shouts of joy. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the word of the Lord is upright; And all His work is done in faithfulness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He loveth righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the lovingkindness of the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

From the place of His habitation He looketh intently Upon all the inhabitants of the earth; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their doings. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Behold, the eye of the Lord is toward them that fear Him, Toward them that wait for His mercy; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Our soul hath waited for the Lord ; He is our help and our shield. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For in Him doth our heart rejoice, Because we have trusted in His holy name.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let Thy mercy, O Lord , be upon us, According as we have waited for Thee. <span class="anchor"
34: 34 [A Psalm] of David; when he changed his demeanour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. א <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth. ב <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My soul shall glory in the Lord ; The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad. ג <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O magnify the Lord with me, And let us exalt His name together. ד <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I sought the Lord , and He answered me, And delivered me from all my fears. ה <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They looked unto Him, and were radiant; ו And their faces shall never be abashed. ז <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
This poor man cried, and the Lord heard, And saved him out of all his troubles. ח <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear Him, And delivereth them. ט <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O consider and see that the Lord is good; Happy is the man that taketh refuge in Him. י <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O fear the Lord , ye His holy ones; For there is no want to them that fear Him. כ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek the Lord want not any good thing. ל <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Come, ye children, hearken unto me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord . מ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who is the man that desireth life, And loveth days, that he may see good therein? נ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile. ס <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it. ע <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous, And His ears are open unto their cry. פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They cried, and the Lord heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles. ק <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit. ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Many are the ills of the righteous, But the Lord delivereth him out of them all. ש <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He keepeth all his bones; Not one of them is broken. ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Evil shall kill the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be held guilty. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

35: 35 [A Psalm] of David. Strive, O Lord , with them that strive with me; Fight against them that fight against me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Take hold of shield and buckler, And rise up to my help. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Let them be as chaff before the wind, The angel of the Lord thrusting them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let their way be dark and slippery, The angel of the Lord pursuing them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For without cause have they hid for me the pit, even their net, Without cause have they digged for my soul. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself; With destruction let him fall therein. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord ; It shall rejoice in His salvation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They repay me evil for good; Bereavement is come to my soul. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth, I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer, may it return into mine own bosom. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I went about as though it had been my friend or my brother; I bowed down mournful, as one that mourneth for his mother. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

But when I halt they rejoice, and gather themselves together; The abjects gather themselves together against me, and those whom I know not; They tear me, and cease not; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
With the profanest mockeries of backbiting They gnash at me with their teeth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lord, how long wilt Thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, Mine only one from the lions. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will give Thee thanks in the great congregation; I will praise Thee among a numerous people. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let not them that are wrongfully mine enemies rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yea, they open their mouth wide against me; They say: 'Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast seen, O Lord ; keep not silence; O Lord, be not far from me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Rouse Thee, and awake to my judgment, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them not say in their heart: 'Aha, we have our desire'; Let them not say: 'We have swallowed him up.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them be ashamed and abashed together that rejoice at my hurt;  ​ Let them be clothed with shame and confusion that magnify themselves against me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that delight in my righteousness; Yea, let them say continually: 'Magnified be the Lord , Who delighteth in the peace of His servant.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And my tongue shall speak of Thy righteousness, And of Thy praise all the day. <span class="anchor"
36: 36 For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the Lord <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Transgression speaketh to the wicked, methinks— There is no fear of God before his eyes. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For it flattereth him in his eyes, Until his iniquity be found, and he be hated. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thy lovingkindness, O Lord , is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness reacheth unto the skies. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Thy house; And Thou makest them drink of the river of Thy pleasures. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For with Thee is the fountain of life; In Thy light do we see light. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O continue Thy lovingkindness unto them that know Thee; And Thy righteousness to the upright in heart. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let not the foot of pride overtake me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
There are the workers of iniquity fallen; They are thrust down, and are not able to rise. <span class="anchor"
37: 37 [A Psalm] of David. א Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, Neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For they shall soon wither like the grass, And fade as the green herb. ב <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

So shalt thou delight thyself in the Lord ; And He shall give thee the petitions of thy heart. ג <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Commit thy way unto the Lord ; Trust also in Him, and He will bring it to pass. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And He will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, And thy right as the noonday.   ​ ד <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Resign thyself unto the Lord , and wait patiently for Him; Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass. ה <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For evil-doers shall be cut off; But those that wait for the Lord , they shall inherit the land. ו <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And yet a little while, and the wicked is no more; Yea, thou shalt look well at his place, and he is not. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The wicked plotteth against the righteous, And gnasheth at him with his teeth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord doth laugh at him; For He seeth that his day is coming. ח <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow; To cast down the poor and needy, To slay such as are upright in the way; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; But the Lord upholdeth the righteous. י <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord knoweth the days of them that are whole-hearted; And their inheritance shall be for ever. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They shall not be ashamed in the time of evil; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied. כ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs— They shall pass away in smoke, they shall pass away. ל <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The wicked borroweth, and payeth not; But the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For such as are blessed of Him shall inherit the land; And they that are cursed of Him shall be cut off. מ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
It is of the Lord that a man's goings are established; And He delighted in his way. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For the Lord upholdeth his hand. נ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed. ס <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the Lord loveth justice, And forsaketh not His saints; They are preserved for ever; But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever. פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The mouth of the righteous uttereth wisdom, And his tongue speaketh justice. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps slide. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord will not leave him in his hand, Nor suffer him to be condemned when he is judged. ק <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Wait for the Lord , and keep His way, And He will exalt thee to inherit the land; When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it. ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a leafy tree in its native soil. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But one passed by, and, lo, he was not; Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found. ש <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Mark the man of integrity, and behold the upright; For there is a future for the man of peace. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But transgressors shall be destroyed together; The future of the wicked shall be cut off. ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

38: 38 A Psalm of David, to make memorial. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , rebuke me not in Thine anger; Neither chasten me in Thy wrath. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thine arrows are gone deep into me, And Thy hand is come down upon me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For mine iniquities are gone over my head; As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My wounds are noisome, they fester, Because of my foolishness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am benumbed and sore crushed; I groan by reason of the moaning of my heart. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lord, all my desire is before Thee; And my sighing is not hid from Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My heart fluttereth, my strength faileth me; As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For I am ready to halt, And my pain is continually before me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For I do declare mine iniquity; I am full of care because of my sin. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

39: 39 For the Leader, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

42: 42 For the Leader; Maschil of the sons of Korah. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

47: 47 For the Leader; a Psalm of the sons of Korah. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
