Bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of His praise to be heard; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who hath set our soul in life, And suffered not our foot to be moved, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou, O God, hast tried us; Thou hast refined us, as silver is refined. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou didst bring us into the hold; Thou didst lay constraint upon our loins. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But Thou didst bring us out unto abundance. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will come into Thy house with burnt-offerings, I will perform unto Thee my vows, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Which my lips have uttered, And my mouth hath spoken, when I was in distress. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will offer unto Thee burnt-offerings of fatlings,  ​ With the sweet smoke of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Come, and hearken, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what He hath done for my soul. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I cried unto Him with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
If I had regarded iniquity in my heart, The Lord would not hear; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me. <span class="anchor"
67: 67 For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm, a Song. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
God be gracious unto us, and bless us; May He cause His face to shine toward us; Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
That Thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For Thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And lead the nations upon earth. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The earth hath yielded her increase; May God, our own God, bless us. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
May God bless us; And let all the ends of the earth fear Him. <span class="anchor"
68: 68 For the Leader. A Psalm of David, a Song. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered; And let them that hate Him flee before Him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
As smoke is driven away, so drive them away; As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But let the righteous be glad, let them exult before God; Yea, let them rejoice with gladness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sing unto God, sing praises to His name; Extol Him that rideth upon the skies, whose name is the Lord ; And exult ye before Him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in His holy habitation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
God maketh the solitary to dwell in a house; He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; The rebellious dwell but in a parched land. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O God, when Thou wentest forth before Thy people, When Thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God; Even yon Sinai trembled at the presence of God, the God of Israel.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
A bounteous rain didst Thou pour down, O God; When Thine inheritance was weary, Thou didst confirm it. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thy flock settled therein; Thou didst prepare in Thy goodness for the poor, O God. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord giveth the word; The women that proclaim the tidings are a great host. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When ye lie among the sheepfolds, The wings of the dove are covered with silver, And her pinions with the shimmer of gold. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When the Almighty scattereth kings therein, It snoweth in Zalmon. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Why look ye askance, ye mountains of peaks, At the mountain which God hath desired for His abode? Yea, the Lord will dwell therein for ever. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The chariots of God are myriads, even thousands upon thousands; The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in holiness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Thou hast ascended on high, Thou hast led captivity captive; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, among the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell there. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Blessed be the Lord, day by day He beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto God the Lord belong the issues of death. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Surely God will smite through the head of His enemies, The hairy scalp of him that goeth about in his guiltiness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord said: 'I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
That thy foot may wade through blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from thine enemies.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They see Thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, in holiness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The singers go before, the minstrels follow after, In the midst of damsels playing upon timbrels. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Bless ye God in full assemblies, Even the Lord, ye that are from the fountain of Israel.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, The princes of Judah their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thy God hath commanded thy strength; Be strong, O God, Thou that hast wrought for us <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Out of Thy temple at Jerusalem, Whither kings shall bring presents unto Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Every one submitting himself with pieces of silver; He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war!  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Nobles shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall hasten to stretch out her hands unto God. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To Him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which are of old; Lo, He uttereth His voice, a mighty voice. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Ascribe ye strength unto God; His majesty is over Israel, And His strength is in the skies. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Awful is God out of thy holy places; The God of Israel, He giveth strength and power unto the people; Blessed be God. <span class="anchor"
69: 69 For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Save me, O God; For the waters are come in even unto the soul. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am sunk in deep mire, where there is no standing; I am come into deep waters, and the flood overwhelmeth me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am weary of my crying; my throat is dried; Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are many; Should I restore that which I took not away? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O God, Thou knowest my folly; And my trespasses are not hid from Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let not them that wait for Thee be ashamed through me, O Lord God of hosts; Let not those that seek Thee be brought to confusion through me, O God of Israel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Because for Thy sake I have borne reproach; Confusion hath covered my face. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Because zeal for Thy house hath eaten me up, And the reproaches of them that reproach Thee are fallen upon me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And I wept with my soul with fasting, And that became unto me a reproach. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I made sackcloth also my garment, And I became a byword unto them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They that sit in the gate talk of me; And I am the song of the drunkards. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, let my prayer be unto Thee, O Lord , in an acceptable time; O God, in the abundance of Thy mercy, Answer me with the truth of Thy salvation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut her mouth upon me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Answer me, O Lord , for Thy mercy is good; According to the multitude of Thy compassions turn Thou unto me.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And hide not Thy face from Thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it; Ransom me because of mine enemies. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my confusion; Mine adversaries are all before Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am sore sick; And I looked for some to show compassion, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yea, they put poison into my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, let it become a trap. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; And make their loins continually to totter. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Pour out Thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of Thine anger overtake them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let their encampment be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For they persecute him whom Thou hast smitten; And they tell of the pain of those whom Thou hast wounded. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into Thy righteousness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But I am afflicted and in pain; Let Thy salvation, O God, set me up on high. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify Him with thanksgiving. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And it shall please the Lord better than a bullock That hath horns and hoofs. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The humble shall see it, and be glad; Ye that seek after God, let your heart revive. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the Lord hearkeneth unto the needy, And despiseth not His prisoners. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas, and every thing that moveth therein. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The seed also of His servants shall inherit it; And they that love His name shall dwell therein. <span class="anchor"
70: 70 For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David; to make memorial. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O God, to deliver me, O Lord , to help me, make haste. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them be ashamed and abashed That seek after my soul; Let them be turned backward and brought to confusion That delight in my hurt. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say: 'Aha, aha.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; And let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'Let God be magnified.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But I am poor and needy,  ​ O God, make haste unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord , tarry not. <span class="anchor"
71: 71 In Thee, O Lord , have I taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Deliver me in Thy righteousness, and rescue me; Incline Thine ear unto me, and save me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Be Thou to me a sheltering rock, whereunto I may continually resort, Which Thou hast appointed to save me; For Thou art my rock and my fortress. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O my God, rescue me out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the grasp of the unrighteous and ruthless man. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For Thou art my hope; O Lord God , my trust from my youth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Upon Thee have I stayed myself from birth; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's womb; My praise is continually of Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am as a wonder unto many; But Thou art my strong refuge. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My mouth shall be filled with Thy praise, And with Thy glory all the day. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Cast me not off in the time of old age; When my strength faileth, forsake me not. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For mine enemies speak concerning me, And they that watch for my soul take counsel together, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Saying: 'God hath forsaken him; Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them be ashamed and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and confusion that seek my hurt. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, I will hope continually, And will praise Thee yet more and more. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My mouth shall tell of Thy righteousness, And of Thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will come with Thy mighty acts, O Lord God ; I will make mention of Thy righteousness, even of Thine only. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O God, Thou hast taught me from my youth; And until now do I declare Thy wondrous works. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And even unto old age and hoary hairs, O God, forsake me not; Until I have declared Thy strength unto the next generation, Thy might to every one that is to come. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thy righteousness also, O God, which reacheth unto high heaven; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto Thee? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou, who hast made me to see many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken me again, and bring me up again from the depths of the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou wilt increase my greatness, And turn and comfort me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I also will give thanks unto Thee with the psaltery, Even unto Thy truth, O my God; I will sing praises unto Thee with the harp,  ​ O Thou Holy One of Israel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing praises unto Thee; And my soul, which Thou hast redeemed. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My tongue also shall tell of Thy righteousness all the day; For they are ashamed, for they are abashed, that seek my hurt. <span class="anchor"
72: 72 [A Psalm] of Solomon. Give the king Thy judgments, O God, And Thy righteousness unto the king's son; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
That he may judge Thy people with righteousness, And Thy poor with justice. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let the mountains bear peace to the people, And the hills, through righteousness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
May he judge the poor of the people, And save the children of the needy, And crush the oppressor. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They shall fear Thee while the sun endureth, And so long as the moon, throughout all generations. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
May he come down like rain upon the mown grass, As showers that water the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In his days let the righteous flourish, And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
May he have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them that dwell in the wilderness bow before him; And his enemies lick the dust. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute; The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yea, all kings shall prostrate themselves before him; All nations shall serve him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For he will deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence, And precious will their blood be in his sight. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
That they may live, and that he may give them of the gold of Sheba, That they may pray for him continually, Yea, bless him all the day. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

May he be as a rich cornfield in the land upon the top of the mountains; May his fruit rustle like Lebanon; And may they blossom out of the city like grass of the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
May his name endure for ever; May his name be continued as long as the sun; May men also bless themselves by him; May all nations call him happy. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And blessed be His glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen, and Amen. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.   ​ ספר שלישי BOOK III <span class="anchor"
73: 73 A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, Even to such as are pure in heart. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For there are no pangs at their death, And their body is sound. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
In the trouble of man they are not; Neither are they plagued like men. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Their eyes stand forth from fatness; They are gone beyond the imaginations of their heart. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression; They speak as if there were none on high. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They have set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Therefore His people return hither; And waters of fullness are drained out by them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And they say: 'How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?' <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Behold, such are the wicked; And they that are always at ease increase riches. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For all the day have I been plagued, And my chastisement came every morning. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
If I had said: 'I will speak thus', Behold, I had been faithless to the generation of Thy children. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And when I pondered how I might know this, It was wearisome in mine eyes; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Until I entered into the sanctuary of God, And considered their end. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Surely Thou settest them in slippery places; Thou hurlest them down to utter ruin. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are wholly consumed by terrors. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when Thou arousest Thyself, Thou wilt despise their semblance. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For my heart was in a ferment, And I was pricked in my reins. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But I was brutish, and ignorant; I was as a beast before Thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Nevertheless I am continually with Thee; Thou holdest my right hand. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou wilt guide me with Thy counsel, And afterward receive me with glory. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Whom have I in heaven but Thee? And beside Thee I desire none upon earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For, lo, they that go far from Thee shall perish; Thou dost destroy all them that go astray from Thee.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
But as for me, the nearness of God is my good; I have made the Lord God my refuge, That I may tell of all Thy works. <span class="anchor"
74: 74 Maschil of Asaph. Why, O God, hast Thou cast us off for ever? Why doth Thine anger smoke against the flock of Thy pasture? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast gotten of old, Which Thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of Thine inheritance; And mount Zion, wherein Thou hast dwelt. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lift up Thy steps because of the perpetual ruins, Even all the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of Thy meeting-place; They have set up their own signs for signs. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
It seemed as when men wield upwards Axes in a thicket of trees. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And now all the carved work thereof together They strike down with hatchet and hammers. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They have set Thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of Thy name even to the ground. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They said in their heart: 'Let us make havoc of them altogether'; They have burned up all the meeting-places of God in the land. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
We see not our signs; There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Why withdrawest Thou Thy hand, even Thy right hand? Draw it out of Thy bosom and consume them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou didst break the sea in pieces by Thy strength; Thou didst shatter the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou didst crush the heads of leviathan, Thou gavest him to be food to the folk inhabiting the wilderness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou didst cleave fountain and brook; Thou driedst up ever-flowing rivers. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thine is the day, Thine also the night; Thou hast established luminary and sun. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast set all the borders of the earth; Thou hast made summer and winter. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Remember this, how the enemy hath reproached the Lord , And how a base people have blasphemed Thy name. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O deliver not the soul of Thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast; Forget not the life of Thy poor for ever. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Look upon the covenant; For the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of violence. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O let not the oppressed turn back in confusion; Let the poor and needy praise Thy name. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Arise, O God, plead Thine own cause;  ​ Remember Thy reproach all the day at the hand of the base man. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Forget not the voice of Thine adversaries, The tumult of those that rise up against Thee which ascendeth continually. <span class="anchor"
75: 75 For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
We give thanks unto Thee, O God, We give thanks, and Thy name is near; Men tell of Thy wondrous works. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When I take the appointed time, I Myself will judge with equity. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
When the earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved, I Myself establish the pillars of it.' Selah <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

76: 76 For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

77: 77 For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

78: 78 Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

79: 79 A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the heathen are come into Thine inheritance; They have defiled Thy holy temple; They have made Jerusalem into heaps. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

81: 81 For the Leader; upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

85: 85 For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The eyes of all wait for Thee, And Thou givest them their food in due season. פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou openest Thy hand, And satisfiest every living thing with favour. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is righteous in all His ways, And gracious in all His works. ק <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon Him, To all that call upon Him in truth. ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord preserveth all them that love Him; But all the wicked will He destroy. ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord ; And let all flesh bless His holy name for ever and ever. <span class="anchor"
146: 146 Hallelujah. Praise the Lord , O my soul. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I will praise the Lord while I live; I will sing praises unto my God while I have my being. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his dust; In that very day his thoughts perish. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Happy is he whose help is the God of Jacob, Whose hope is in the Lord his God, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth bread to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind; The Lord raiseth up them that are bowed down; The Lord loveth the righteous; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord preserveth the strangers; He upholdeth the fatherless and the widow; But the way of the wicked He maketh crooked. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Hallelujah. <span class="anchor"
147: 147 Hallelujah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord doth build up Jerusalem, He gathereth together the dispersed of Israel; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He counteth the number of the stars; He giveth them all their names. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord upholdeth the humble; He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving, Sing praises upon the harp unto our God; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who covereth the heaven with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh the mountains to spring with grass. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He giveth to the beast his food, And to the young ravens which cry. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He delighteth not in the strength of the horse; He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear Him, In those that wait for His mercy. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Glorify the Lord , O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For He hath made strong the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He maketh thy borders peace; He giveth thee in plenty the fat of wheat. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He sendeth out His commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He casteth forth His ice like crumbs; Who can stand before His cold? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He sendeth forth His word, and melteth them; He causeth His wind to blow, and the waters flow. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He declareth His word unto Jacob, His statutes and His ordinances unto Israel. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for His ordinances, they have not known them. Hallelujah. <span class="anchor"
148: 148 Hallelujah. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise ye Him, all His angels; Praise ye Him, all His hosts. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise ye Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all ye stars of light. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise Him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them praise the name of the Lord ; For He commanded, and they were created. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath also established them for ever and ever; He hath made a decree which shall not be transgressed. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise the Lord from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Fire and hail, snow and vapour, Stormy wind, fulfilling His word; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Mountains and all hills, Fruitful trees and all cedars; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Beasts and all cattle, Creeping things and winged fowl; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Kings of the earth and all peoples, Princes and all judges of the earth; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Both young men and maidens, Old men and children; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let them praise the name of the Lord , For His name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and heaven. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And He hath lifted up a horn for His people, A praise for all His saints, Even for the children of Israel, a people near unto Him. Hallelujah.   ​ <span class="anchor"

Let them praise His name in the dance; Let them sing praises unto Him with the timbrel and harp. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To execute upon them the judgment written; He is the glory of all His saints. Hallelujah. <span class="anchor"
150: 150 Hallelujah. Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in the firmament of His power. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise Him for His mighty acts; Praise Him according to His abundant greatness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise Him with the blast of the horn; Praise Him with the psaltery and harp. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; Praise Him with stringed instruments and the pipe. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Praise Him with the loud-sounding cymbals; Praise Him with the clanging cymbals. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
